label: Unbounded-grades rival of grades-to-maximum at being survives, checked
description: Rival test for grades-to-maximum at being against its smallest consumer, SelectedAncestryUnique.uniqueRoot (premises: a necessary root ancestor of the selected being, excluded middle, the genus principle at being, the existence-to-act contract, the esse-cause bridge, grades-to-maximum at being). On the natural numbers ordered by size, all necessary and ungrounded, the unbounded-grades rival holds with the other five premises and there are many necessary roots, so none is unique. Two of the other premises hold vacuously there. Model-witnessed survival only.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.ascent at its one world with ascentAct, ascentMore, ascentCause and selected being 0: the rival, NecessaryRootAncestor, excluded middle, MaximumInBeingCausesAllBeingsReading, ExistingInActAt and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround hold; UniqueNecessaryActualRootAt fails. Consumer tested: SelectedAncestryUnique.uniqueRoot.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct, MoreIn and esse as the premise; one world, natural-number candidates, strict order with no top.
research_comparisons.coverage: One infinite interpretation; the genus principle and the esse-cause bridge hold vacuously there, so a model with a working causal order and unbounded grades is not exhibited.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one InAct, MoreIn and esse (unregistered helper unboundedGrades_exclude).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.ascent in Control.UnboundedGradesSurvive; unboundedGradesSurvive proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Compare the rival with the two recorded derivations of the premise (from no infinite ascent in being, and from grading by approach to a primary): each derivation's premises jointly exclude the rival, so its holder must deny one premise of each.
